title: Bendera Blok C
mood: proud, loud and a little chaotic
subject: neighbours hanging a fifteen-storey flag down the side of their flats on the night of 30 August
caption: Malaysian Merdeka patriotic anthem in the modern lagu perpaduan style. A marching snare playing military rudiments that turns into big half-time pop-rock drums with floor-tom builds, a French horn and trumpet fanfare between lines, a driving orchestral string ostinato, piano carrying the verses, and overdriven rhythm guitars thickening the chorus. Starts close and narrow with piano and snare, then opens wide for the chorus, with a stacked mixed choir in the final chorus after a key change up. Proud, declamatory male lead in a strong tenor, with massed unison group vocals and chanted refrains. 92 BPM, Bb major. Proud, loud and a little chaotic. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no intimate whisper vocal, no slow-ballad tempo drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - marching snare and horn fanfare]

[Verse 1]
Tiga puluh Ogos, pukul sepuluh malam
Uncle Lim tingkat lima belas pegang tali, tangan menggigil
Kak Yati bawa cable tie satu plastik penuh
Anak Muthu jerit dari bawah, "Kiri sikit! Kiri lagi!"

[Pre-Chorus]
Bendera ni panjang lima belas tingkat
Jahit sendiri, tiga minggu kat bawah blok

[Chorus]
Turun, turun, Blok C!
(Blok C! Blok C!)
Jalur Gemilang lalu depan tingkap semua orang
Esok pagi orang lalu tol pun boleh nampak

[Verse 2]
Tingkat sembilan tersangkut kat aircon rumah Pak Abu
Pak Abu keluar berkain pelikat, panjat kerusi, tarik sekali
Satu blok tepuk tangan, ada yang rakam, ada yang hon motor
Pak guard tinggal pondok, datang suluh dengan lampu picit

[Bridge - snare roll, choir enters, key change up]
Bintang empat belas bucu, ada tiga yang senget
Kak Yati kata biar, baru orang tahu kita yang jahit

[Chorus]
Turun, turun, Blok C!
(Blok C! Blok C!)
Jalur Gemilang lalu depan tingkap semua orang
Pagi tiga puluh satu, Uncle Lim nak bergambar kat bawah

[Outro - choir chant over big drums]
Merdeka! Blok C!
Tingkat sembilan, terima kasih, Pak Abu
